summary: Iter 63 REGRESSION after LARGE internal refactor (misc.py -> 8 routers, courses.py -> package with 6 modules, services extracted: enrollment_service + course_lifecycle_service, frontend React.lazy + ErrorBoundary). Backend: 28/28 pytest cases PASS across all refactored endpoint groups and new service extractions. Split routers all serve correct shapes/status codes (enrollments, certificates, notifications, gamification, admin/analytics, catalog, billing). Course package: publish-without-slides -> 400, delete-while-published -> 409, archive-blocked-when-learner-busy -> 409, unpublish/archive/unarchive OK, duplicate copies image_position + media_opacity slide fields (bug fix verified). Enrollment service: enroll idempotent (already=true on re-enroll), progress save OK, complete awards XP+cert, second complete returns already_completed. Ratings/reviews, prerequisites CRUD, slide add/update/reorder/delete/versions, rich-text sanitize all pass. Frontend: all 13 lazy-loaded admin routes render with sidebar (dashboard/courses/exams/certificates/leaderboard/imports/users/reports/settings/preferences/live-sessions/billing/courses/243/edit). Learner /learn/243 renders full 99-slide course with all sidebar items (Contents, Introduction, Skeleton, ...), Next button advances slides, and 'Resumed where you left off' toast confirms progress persists across re-entry. ErrorBoundary NOT visible on any healthy page. Zero console errors across the entire admin+learner journey.
critical_code_review_comments: Route split for misc.py -> ai/enrollments/certificates/notifications/gamification/admin_analytics/billing/catalog is clean; each keeps its original URL prefix so no client-side changes were required. Verified against live 200s.

Course package (routers/courses/{crud,enrollment,ratings,slides,prerequisites,common}.py) correctly reuses a single shared `router` object via common.py — registration order preserved. All lifecycle endpoints (publish/archive/delete/duplicate) return correct 4xx guards.

services/course_lifecycle_service.py::duplicate() properly copies image_position AND media_opacity — verified end-to-end (creates slide with image_position='beside', media_opacity=75 then duplicates and reads back identical values from the copy).
services/enrollment_service.py preserves idempotent semantics on re-enroll (returns already=true) and second complete (returns already_completed=true).

Frontend App.tsx lazy-loads all non-critical routes with a single top-level Suspense fallback; ErrorBoundary wraps the whole tree. Verified data-testid='error-boundary' does NOT render on any healthy page.
Zero console errors across the tested admin+learner journeys — solid regression signal that chunk loading & code-split imports resolve reliably from the preview edge.
